datasets.name: ds_filter_values
queryLines:
-- Values for the global filter widgets (one row per combination present in the results).
SELECT DISTINCT
  run_date,
  coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)') AS project,
  data_layer, catalog, criticality, rule_dimension
FROM v_results_all
WHERE row_level = 'rule'

datasets.name: ds_p1_kpis
queryLines:
-- 1.1-1.6 KPI row (one row). Latest day = newest run_date inside the selected range; comparisons use the
-- previous data day (1.4, 1.6) and the 7 days before the latest 7 (1.1). Weighted DQ score: high 3, medium 2, low 1.
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    run_date,
    SUM(IF(is_pass, crit_weight, 0)) AS w_pass,
    SUM(IF(is_scored, crit_weight, 0)) AS w_scored,
    COUNT_IF(row_level = 'rule') AS rules,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'error') AS errors,
    COALESCE(SUM(rows_quarantined), 0) AS quarantined,
    SUM(rows_evaluated) AS evaluated,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'code_error') AS code_errors
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
  GROUP BY run_date
),
d AS (
  SELECT MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) AS latest FROM daily
),
k AS (
  SELECT
    d.latest,
    MAX(IF(x.run_date < d.latest, x.run_date, NULL)) AS previous,
    SUM(IF(x.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.latest, 6) AND d.latest, x.w_pass, 0))
      / NULLIF(SUM(IF(x.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.latest, 6) AND d.latest, x.w_scored, 0)), 0) AS wscore_7d,
    SUM(IF(x.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.latest, 13) AND date_sub(d.latest, 7), x.w_pass, 0))
      / NULLIF(SUM(IF(x.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.latest, 13) AND date_sub(d.latest, 7), x.w_scored, 0)), 0) AS wscore_prev_7d,
    MAX(IF(x.run_date = d.latest, x.rules, NULL)) AS rules_today,
    MAX(IF(x.run_date = d.latest, x.errors, NULL)) AS failed_today,
    MAX(IF(x.run_date = d.latest, x.quarantined, NULL)) AS quarantined_today,
    MAX(IF(x.run_date = d.latest, x.evaluated, NULL)) AS evaluated_today,
    MAX(IF(x.run_date = d.latest, x.code_errors, NULL)) AS code_error_today
  FROM daily x CROSS JOIN d
  GROUP BY d.latest
),
p AS (
  SELECT k.*,
         MAX(IF(x.run_date = k.previous, x.errors, NULL)) AS failed_previous,
         MAX(IF(x.run_date = k.previous, x.code_errors, NULL)) AS code_error_previous
  FROM k CROSS JOIN daily x
  GROUP BY ALL
),
a AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT table_id) AS tables_monitored, COUNT(*) AS active_rules
  FROM v_assignment_active
  WHERE is_effective_active
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT
  date_format(p.latest, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS latest_day,
  date_format(p.previous, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS previous_day,
  p.wscore_7d, p.wscore_prev_7d,
  a.tables_monitored, a.active_rules, COALESCE(p.rules_today, 0) AS rules_today,
  COALESCE(p.failed_today, 0) AS failed_today, p.failed_previous,
  COALESCE(p.quarantined_today, 0) AS quarantined_today, p.evaluated_today,
  concat(format_number(100 * p.quarantined_today / NULLIF(p.evaluated_today, 0), 2), ' % of rows evaluated') AS quarantined_share,
  COALESCE(p.code_error_today, 0) AS code_error_today, p.code_error_previous
FROM p CROSS JOIN a

datasets.name: ds_p1_last_success
queryLines:
-- 1.7 Time since the newest execution that finished without code_error, up to the end of the selected range.
-- Reference time = v_data_mode.as_of_ts (end of the newest run when dates are simulated, otherwise now).
SELECT
  ROUND((unix_seconds(m.as_of_ts) - unix_seconds(s.last_success)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_since_success,
  concat(date_format(s.last_success, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC') AS last_success_label
FROM (
  SELECT MAX(run_end_ts) AS last_success
  FROM v_runs
  WHERE is_successful AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
) s
CROSS JOIN v_data_mode m

datasets.name: ds_p1_trend
queryLines:
-- 1.8 Daily DQ score and weighted DQ score in the selected range, with the 95 % SLA as a reference series.
SELECT
  run_date,
  SUM(INT(is_pass)) / NULLIF(SUM(INT(is_scored)), 0) AS dq_score,
  SUM(IF(is_pass, crit_weight, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(IF(is_scored, crit_weight, 0)), 0) AS weighted_dq_score,
  0.95 AS sla
FROM v_results_all
WHERE is_latest_for_day AND row_level = 'rule'
  AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
GROUP BY run_date
ORDER BY run_date

datasets.name: ds_p1_latest_status
queryLines:
-- 1.9 Result status on the latest day inside the selected range (rule results + table-level faults).
WITH f AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS results,
       CASE status WHEN 'pass' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'error' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS status_order
FROM f
WHERE run_date = (SELECT MAX(run_date) FROM f)
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status_order

datasets.name: ds_p1_heatmap
queryLines:
-- 1.10 Table x day health for the last 30 days of the selected range (ending at the newest data day in the range).
-- One row per table x day (full grid): status = worst status of the day (error > warning > pass); a day with only
-- code_error or without a run is 'code_error / no run' (grey).
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(run_date) OVER () AS last_d FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
cells AS (
  SELECT concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label, run_date, MAX(last_d) AS last_d,
         MAX(CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS health,
         COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS failed_rules,
         COUNT_IF(row_level = 'rule') AS rules
  FROM f
  WHERE run_date > date_sub(last_d, 30)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
per_table AS (
  SELECT table_label, MAX(last_d) AS last_d,
         map_from_entries(collect_list(struct(run_date, named_struct('health', health, 'failed_rules', failed_rules,
                                                                     'rules', rules)))) AS m
  FROM cells
  GROUP BY 1
)
-- single pass: every table gets every day of the window (a missing day = no run)
SELECT
  table_label,
  date_format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS day,
  CASE m[d].health WHEN 3 THEN 'error' WHEN 2 THEN 'warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'code_error / no run' END AS status,
  COALESCE(m[d].failed_rules, 0) AS failed_rules,
  COALESCE(m[d].rules, 0) AS rules
FROM per_table
LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(greatest(date_sub(last_d, 29), :run_dates.min), last_d)) x AS d
ORDER BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_p1_worst_tables
queryLines:
-- 1.11 Top 10 tables by failed rule results (error + warning) in the 7 days up to the latest day of the range.
-- One row per (table, status) so the bar can be colored by status.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND row_level = 'rule' AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
w AS (
  SELECT concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label, status
  FROM f
  WHERE run_date > date_sub((SELECT MAX(run_date) FROM f), 7) AND status IN ('error', 'warning')
),
top AS (
  SELECT table_label, COUNT(*) AS failed_results FROM w GROUP BY table_label
  ORDER BY failed_results DESC, table_label LIMIT 10
)
SELECT w.table_label, w.status, COUNT(*) AS results, MAX(top.failed_results) AS failed_results
FROM w JOIN top ON top.table_label = w.table_label
GROUP BY w.table_label, w.status
ORDER BY failed_results DESC, w.table_label, w.status

WITH f AS (

datasets.name: ds_p2_selected
queryLines:
-- 2.x The selected table with its configuration, one row per table_choice (page filter "Table").
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
cand AS (
  SELECT table_label, run_date, COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS bad,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'code_error') AS ce, COALESCE(SUM(rows_failed), 0) AS rf,
         MAX(run_date) OVER () AS last_day
  FROM f WHERE row_level = 'rule'
  GROUP BY table_label, run_date
),
worst AS (
  SELECT MIN_BY(table_label, named_struct('bad', -bad, 'ce', -ce, 'rf', -rf, 't', table_label)) AS worst_table
  FROM cand WHERE run_date = last_day
)
SELECT c.table_choice, f.table_label,
       MAX(f.data_layer) AS data_layer,
       array_join(array_sort(collect_set(coalesce(f.project, '(project-agnostic)'))), ', ') AS projects,
       MAX(f.filter_field) AS filter_field,
       MAX(f.quarantine) AS quarantine_table,
       IF(c.table_choice = '(worst table)', 'worst table of the latest day', 'selected') AS selection
FROM f
CROSS JOIN worst w
LATERAL VIEW explode(IF(f.table_label = w.worst_table, array(f.table_label, '(worst table)'), array(f.table_label))) c AS table_choice
GROUP BY c.table_choice, f.table_label

datasets.name: ds_p2_tables
queryLines:
-- 2.1 Monitored tables in the selected range: latest status (worst rule status on the table's newest day), DQ score
-- over the range, rules evaluated on the newest day, last run, failed rows on the newest day, and the status of the
-- last 20 run days (oldest left). Sorted worst first.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
day_status AS (
  SELECT table_label, run_date,
         MAX(CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS health,
         COALESCE(SUM(rows_failed), 0) AS rows_failed,
         COUNT_IF(row_level = 'rule') AS rules,
         COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS failing_rules,
         MAX(run_ts) AS last_run
  FROM f GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY table_label ORDER BY run_date DESC) AS rn FROM day_status
),
per_table AS (
  SELECT table_label,
         MAX(data_layer) AS data_layer,
         array_join(array_sort(collect_set(coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)'))), ', ') AS projects,
         array_join(array_sort(collect_set(apply_at)), ', ') AS apply_at,
         COUNT_IF(is_pass) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored), 0) AS dq_score,
         COUNT(DISTINCT rule_assignment_id) AS assignments
  FROM f GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  p.table_label, p.data_layer, p.projects, p.apply_at, p.assignments,
  CASE CASE l.health WHEN 3 THEN 'error' WHEN 2 THEN 'warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'code_error' END WHEN 'error' THEN '🟥 error' WHEN 'warning' THEN '🟧 warning' WHEN 'pass' THEN '🟩 pass'
       WHEN 'code_error' THEN '⬜ code_error' ELSE '⬜ no run' END AS latest_status,
  p.dq_score, l.failing_rules, l.rows_failed,
  date_format(l.last_run, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS last_run,
  array_join(transform(array_sort(h.days), x -> CASE x.health WHEN 3 THEN '🟥' WHEN 2 THEN '🟧' WHEN 1 THEN '🟩' ELSE '⬜' END), '') AS last_20_days,
  l.health
FROM per_table p
JOIN ranked l ON l.table_label = p.table_label AND l.rn = 1
JOIN (SELECT table_label, collect_list(named_struct('run_date', run_date, 'health', health)) AS days
      FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 20 GROUP BY 1) h ON h.table_label = p.table_label
ORDER BY l.health DESC, l.failing_rules DESC, l.rows_failed DESC, p.table_label

datasets.name: ds_p2_run_history
queryLines:
-- 2.2 Status of each table in each of its last 60 runs (every call, reruns included) up to the end of the range,
-- one set per table_choice. status = worst rule status of the run; a run with only code_error (e.g. a table fault)
-- is grey.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label FROM v_results_all
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
f AS (
  SELECT * FROM r WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date >= :run_dates.min
),
cand AS (
  SELECT table_label, run_date, COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS bad,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'code_error') AS ce, COALESCE(SUM(rows_failed), 0) AS rf,
         MAX(run_date) OVER () AS last_day
  FROM f WHERE row_level = 'rule'
  GROUP BY table_label, run_date
),
worst AS (
  SELECT MIN_BY(table_label, named_struct('bad', -bad, 'ce', -ce, 'rf', -rf, 't', table_label)) AS worst_table
  FROM cand WHERE run_date = last_day
),
runs AS (
  SELECT table_label, result_id, MIN(run_ts) AS run_ts, MAX(run_date) AS run_date,
         MAX(CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS health,
         MAX(rows_evaluated) AS rows_evaluated,
         SUM(rows_failed) / NULLIF(SUM(rows_evaluated), 0) AS failed_share,
         COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS failing_rules,
         COUNT_IF(row_level = 'rule') AS rules
  FROM r
  WHERE table_label IN (SELECT table_label FROM f)
  GROUP BY table_label, result_id
),
last60 AS (
  SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY table_label ORDER BY run_ts DESC, result_id DESC) AS rn FROM runs)
  WHERE rn <= 60
)
SELECT c.table_choice, date_format(run_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS run_label, run_date,
       CASE health WHEN 3 THEN 'error' WHEN 2 THEN 'warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'code_error / no run' END AS status,
       failing_rules, rules
FROM last60
CROSS JOIN worst w
LATERAL VIEW explode(IF(last60.table_label = w.worst_table, array(last60.table_label, '(worst table)'), array(last60.table_label))) c AS table_choice
ORDER BY table_choice, run_label

datasets.name: ds_p2_runs
queryLines:
-- 2.3 / 2.4 Per run in the range, one set per table_choice: % failed rows (failed rows / rows evaluated, summed over
-- the table's rules) with a 1 % reference line, and rows evaluated with the expected band = mean of the previous 14
-- runs (at least 5) +/- max(2 standard deviations, 10 % of the mean); the previous runs may lie before the range
-- start. outside_band = the run is outside that band (e.g. a partial load).
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label FROM v_results_all
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
f AS (
  SELECT * FROM r WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date >= :run_dates.min
),
cand AS (
  SELECT table_label, run_date, COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS bad,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'code_error') AS ce, COALESCE(SUM(rows_failed), 0) AS rf,
         MAX(run_date) OVER () AS last_day
  FROM f WHERE row_level = 'rule'
  GROUP BY table_label, run_date
),
worst AS (
  SELECT MIN_BY(table_label, named_struct('bad', -bad, 'ce', -ce, 'rf', -rf, 't', table_label)) AS worst_table
  FROM cand WHERE run_date = last_day
),
runs AS (
  SELECT table_label, result_id, MIN(run_ts) AS run_ts, MAX(run_date) AS run_date,
         MAX(CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS health,
         MAX(rows_evaluated) AS rows_evaluated,
         SUM(rows_failed) / NULLIF(SUM(rows_evaluated), 0) AS failed_share,
         COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS failing_rules,
         COUNT_IF(row_level = 'rule') AS rules
  FROM r
  WHERE table_label IN (SELECT table_label FROM f)
  GROUP BY table_label, result_id
),
band AS (
  SELECT *,
         AVG(rows_evaluated) OVER w AS mean_prev,
         GREATEST(2 * STDDEV_SAMP(rows_evaluated) OVER w, 0.10 * AVG(rows_evaluated) OVER w) AS half_band,
         COUNT(rows_evaluated) OVER w AS n_prev
  FROM runs
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY table_label ORDER BY run_ts, result_id ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT c.table_choice, run_ts, run_date, rows_evaluated, failed_share, 0.01 AS failed_share_reference,
       IF(n_prev >= 5, GREATEST(mean_prev - half_band, 0), NULL) AS expected_low,
       IF(n_prev >= 5, mean_prev + half_band, NULL) AS expected_high,
       n_prev >= 5 AND (rows_evaluated < mean_prev - half_band OR rows_evaluated > mean_prev + half_band) AS outside_band
FROM band
CROSS JOIN worst w
LATERAL VIEW explode(IF(band.table_label = w.worst_table, array(band.table_label, '(worst table)'), array(band.table_label))) c AS table_choice
WHERE rows_evaluated IS NOT NULL AND run_date >= :run_dates.min
ORDER BY table_choice, run_ts

datasets.name: ds_p2_volume_anomalies
queryLines:
-- 2.4 Runs whose rows evaluated are outside the expected band (same band as p2_runs), one set per table_choice.
WITH r AS (

  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),

  FROM f WHERE row_level = 'rule'
  GROUP BY table_label, run_date

  FROM cand WHERE run_date = last_day
),

         MAX(CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS health,
         MAX(rows_evaluated) AS rows_evaluated,
         SUM(rows_failed) / NULLIF(SUM(rows_evaluated), 0) AS failed_share,
         COUNT_IF(status IN ('error', 'warning')) AS failing_rules,

),

FROM band
CROSS JOIN worst w
LATERAL VIEW explode(IF(band.table_label = w.worst_table, array(band.table_label, '(worst table)'), array(band.table_label))) c AS table_choice
WHERE n_prev >= 5 AND (rows_evaluated < mean_prev - half_band OR rows_evaluated > mean_prev + half_band)
  AND run_date >= :run_dates.min
ORDER BY table_choice, run_ts DESC

datasets.name: ds_p2_rules
queryLines:
-- 2.5 Rules per table_choice: status on the table's newest day in the range, failed rows, failing since (first
-- day of the current warning/error streak; streaks run over the full history), pass rate over the range.
-- Single pass over v_rule_daily (windows only): the worst table (table_rank 1, also returned as '(worst table)') is
-- ranked the same way as in the other page-2 datasets (failing rules on the latest day, code_error, failed rows, name).
WITH dly AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_rule_daily
  WHERE run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
z AS (
  SELECT dly.*, MAX(run_date) OVER () AS last_day FROM dly
),
z2 AS (
  SELECT z.*,
         MAX(IF(run_date = last_day, 1, 0)) OVER t AS t_has_last,
         SUM(IF(run_date = last_day AND status IN ('error', 'warning'), 1, 0)) OVER t AS t_bad,
         SUM(IF(run_date = last_day AND status = 'code_error', 1, 0)) OVER t AS t_ce,
         SUM(IF(run_date = last_day, COALESCE(rows_failed, 0), 0)) OVER t AS t_rf
  FROM z
  WINDOW t AS (PARTITION BY table_label)
),
z3 AS (
  SELECT z2.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t_has_last DESC, t_bad DESC, t_ce DESC, t_rf DESC, table_label) AS table_rank
  FROM z2
),
t AS (
  SELECT z3.*,
         MAX(run_date) OVER a AS a_last_day,
         SUM(IF(is_pass, 1, 0)) OVER a / NULLIF(SUM(IF(is_scored, 1, 0)) OVER a, 0) AS pass_rate
  FROM z3
  WINDOW a AS (PARTITION BY rule_assignment_id)
)
SELECT
  c.table_choice, rule_label, rule_dimension, criticality, apply_at,
  CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN '🟥 error' WHEN 'warning' THEN '🟧 warning' WHEN 'pass' THEN '🟩 pass'
       WHEN 'code_error' THEN '⬜ code_error' ELSE '⬜ no run' END AS status,
  rows_failed,
  IF(state = 'failing', date_format(streak_start, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), NULL) AS failing_since,
  IF(state = 'failing', streak_pos, NULL) AS failing_runs,
  pass_rate,
  CASE status WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 WHEN 'code_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sort_key
FROM t
LATERAL VIEW explode(IF(table_rank = 1, array(table_label, '(worst table)'), array(table_label))) c AS table_choice
WHERE run_date = a_last_day
ORDER BY table_choice, sort_key DESC, failing_runs DESC NULLS LAST, rows_failed DESC, rule_label

GROUP BY a.active_rules, a.active_tables

    array_join(transform(array_sort(collect_list(IF(d.rn_desc <= 20, named_struct('d', d.run_date, 's', d.status), NULL))),
               x -> CASE x.s WHEN 'error' THEN '🟥' WHEN 'warning' THEN '🟧' WHEN 'pass' THEN '🟩' ELSE '⬜' END), '')
                                                                     AS last_20_runs,
    MAX(d.e)                                                         AS e
  FROM dly d
  WHERE d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 90)
  GROUP BY d.rule_assignment_id
),
cls AS (
  SELECT *,
         flips_14d >= 5                                              AS is_flapping,
         scored_90d >= 7 AND pass_90d = scored_90d                    AS is_always_pass,
         scored_30d >= 3 AND pass_rate_30d = 0                        AS is_always_fail,
         last_day = e AND last_status = 'code_error'                  AS is_code_error
  FROM stats
)
SELECT concat(rule_label, ' · ', split_part(table_label, '.', 2)) AS rule_table, assignment_label,
       datediff(last_day, last_streak_start) + 1 AS days_failing, last_streak_pos AS runs_failing,
       last_status AS status, date_format(last_streak_start, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS failing_since
FROM cls
WHERE last_state = 'failing'
ORDER BY days_failing DESC, runs_failing DESC, rule_table
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_p3_always_pass
queryLines:
-- 3.7 Always-pass rule assignments: >= 7 scored runs in the 90 days up to E, all pass. Candidates for tightening.
WITH dly AS (
  SELECT v.*,
         MAX(IF(v.run_date >= :run_dates.min, v.run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.rule_assignment_id ORDER BY v.run_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM v_rule_daily v
  WHERE v.run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.rule_assignment_id,
    MAX(d.assignment_label) AS assignment_label, MAX(d.rule_label) AS rule_label, MAX(d.table_label) AS table_label,
    MAX(d.apply_at) AS apply_at, MAX(d.rule_name) AS rule_name, MAX(d.rule_dimension) AS rule_dimension,
    MAX(d.criticality) AS criticality,
    COUNT_IF(d.is_pass AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 30)) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(d.is_scored AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 30)), 0)
                                                                     AS pass_rate_30d,
    COUNT_IF(d.is_scored AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 30))         AS scored_30d,
    COUNT_IF(d.is_flip AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 14))           AS flips_14d,
    COUNT_IF(d.is_scored AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 90))         AS scored_90d,
    COUNT_IF(d.is_pass AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 90))           AS pass_90d,
    COUNT_IF(d.status = 'code_error' AND d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 30)) AS code_error_30d,
    MAX_BY(d.status, d.run_date)                                     AS last_status,
    MAX_BY(d.state, d.run_date)                                      AS last_state,
    MAX_BY(d.streak_start, d.run_date)                               AS last_streak_start,
    MAX_BY(d.streak_pos, d.run_date)                                 AS last_streak_pos,
    MAX(d.run_date)                                                  AS last_day,
    MAX(d.parameters_identifiers)                                    AS parameters_identifiers,
    MAX(d.parameters_values)                                         AS parameters_values,
    array_join(transform(array_sort(collect_list(IF(d.rn_desc <= 20, named_struct('d', d.run_date, 's', d.status), NULL))),
               x -> CASE x.s WHEN 'error' THEN '🟥' WHEN 'warning' THEN '🟧' WHEN 'pass' THEN '🟩' ELSE '⬜' END), '')
                                                                     AS last_20_runs,
    MAX(d.e)                                                         AS e
  FROM dly d
  WHERE d.run_date > date_sub(d.e, 90)
  GROUP BY d.rule_assignment_id
),
cls AS (
  SELECT *,
         flips_14d >= 5                                              AS is_flapping,
         scored_90d >= 7 AND pass_90d = scored_90d                    AS is_always_pass,
         scored_30d >= 3 AND pass_rate_30d = 0                        AS is_always_fail,
         last_day = e AND last_status = 'code_error'                  AS is_code_error
  FROM stats
)
SELECT rule_label, table_label, apply_at, criticality, scored_90d AS runs_90d,
       concat_ws(' ', parameters_identifiers, parameters_values) AS parameters
FROM cls
WHERE is_always_pass
ORDER BY scored_90d DESC, table_label, rule_label

datasets.name: ds_p4_dimension_score
queryLines:
-- 4.1 DQ score per dimension: the 7 days up to E vs the same 7 days 30 days earlier (E-36 .. E-30).
-- DQ score = pass / (pass + warning + error), latest rule result per day.
WITH dly AS (
  SELECT v.*, MAX(IF(v.run_date >= :run_dates.min, v.run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_rule_daily v
  WHERE v.run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
s AS (
  SELECT rule_dimension,
         COUNT_IF(is_pass AND run_date > date_sub(e, 7)) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored AND run_date > date_sub(e, 7)), 0) AS score_now,
         COUNT_IF(is_pass AND run_date BETWEEN date_sub(e, 36) AND date_sub(e, 30)) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored AND run_date BETWEEN date_sub(e, 36) AND date_sub(e, 30)), 0) AS score_before,
         COUNT_IF(is_scored AND run_date > date_sub(e, 7)) AS results_now
  FROM dly
  WHERE run_date > date_sub(e, 37)
  GROUP BY rule_dimension
)
SELECT rule_dimension, period, score
FROM s
LATERAL VIEW stack(2, 'Last 7 days', score_now, '30 days earlier', score_before) p AS period, score
WHERE results_now > 0
ORDER BY rule_dimension, period

datasets.name: ds_p4_dimension_layer
queryLines:
-- 4.3 DQ score per dimension and layer in the selected range. band: >= 95 % green, 85-95 % amber, < 85 % red,
-- no scored results grey. Every dimension x layer with results in the range is shown, empty cells included.
WITH dly AS (
  SELECT v.*, MAX(IF(v.run_date >= :run_dates.min, v.run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_rule_daily v
  WHERE v.run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
r AS (SELECT * FROM dly WHERE run_date >= :run_dates.min),
cells AS (
  SELECT rule_dimension, data_layer, COUNT_IF(is_pass) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored), 0) AS score, COUNT_IF(is_scored) AS results,
         COUNT(DISTINCT rule_assignment_id) AS assignments
  FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2
),
grid AS (
  SELECT d.rule_dimension, l.data_layer
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT rule_dimension FROM r) d CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT data_layer FROM r) l
)
SELECT g.rule_dimension, g.data_layer, c.score, COALESCE(c.results, 0) AS results,
       COALESCE(c.assignments, 0) AS assignments,
       CASE WHEN c.score IS NULL THEN 'no results' WHEN c.score >= 0.95 THEN '>= 95 %'
            WHEN c.score >= 0.85 THEN '85-95 %' ELSE '< 85 %' END AS band,
       IF(c.score IS NULL, '-', concat(format_number(100 * c.score, 1), ' %')) AS score_label
FROM grid g LEFT JOIN cells c ON c.rule_dimension = g.rule_dimension AND c.data_layer = g.data_layer
ORDER BY g.rule_dimension, g.data_layer

datasets.name: ds_p4_project_scorecard
queryLines:
-- 4.4 Project scorecard (project = the run's project; none = '(project-agnostic)'): tables and rule assignments
-- with results in the range, DQ score over the range, change of the score (7 days up to E vs the 7 days before,
-- in percentage points), open errors = rule assignments whose newest result up to E is error, and warnings.
WITH dly AS (
  SELECT v.*, MAX(IF(v.run_date >= :run_dates.min, v.run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_rule_daily v
  WHERE v.run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
p AS (
  SELECT coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)') AS project_label, *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rule_assignment_id, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')
                            ORDER BY run_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM dly
  WHERE run_date > date_sub(e, 14) OR run_date >= :run_dates.min
)
SELECT project_label AS project,
       COUNT(DISTINCT IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, table_id, NULL)) AS tables,
       COUNT(DISTINCT IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, rule_assignment_id, NULL)) AS rules,
       COUNT_IF(is_pass AND run_date >= :run_dates.min) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored AND run_date >= :run_dates.min), 0) AS score,
       COUNT_IF(is_pass AND run_date > date_sub(e, 7)) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored AND run_date > date_sub(e, 7)), 0)
         - COUNT_IF(is_pass AND run_date BETWEEN date_sub(e, 13) AND date_sub(e, 7)) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored AND run_date BETWEEN date_sub(e, 13) AND date_sub(e, 7)), 0) AS score_change_7d,
       COUNT_IF(rn_desc = 1 AND status = 'error') AS open_errors,
       COUNT_IF(rn_desc = 1 AND status = 'warning') AS open_warnings
FROM p
GROUP BY project_label
HAVING COUNT_IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min) > 0
ORDER BY open_errors DESC, score

datasets.name: ds_p4_coverage_gaps
queryLines:
-- 4.5 Coverage gaps: registered active tables that lack effective active rules in a dimension (only the selected
-- dimensions when the Dimension filter is set), or that have a primary key but no uniqueness rule. Gold and silver
-- first. Layer and Catalog filters apply; the registry has no project or criticality.
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
         filter(missing_dimensions, d -> size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, d)) AS gaps
  FROM v_table_registry
  WHERE table_is_active
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
)
SELECT table_label, data_layer, catalog, active_assignments AS rules,
       array_join(gaps, ', ') AS missing_dimensions,
       array_join(primary_key, ', ') AS primary_key,
       CASE WHEN NOT has_primary_key THEN 'no primary key'
            WHEN has_uniqueness_rule THEN 'yes'
            ELSE '🟥 missing' END AS uniqueness_rule,
       layer_order
FROM t
WHERE size(gaps) > 0 OR (has_primary_key AND NOT has_uniqueness_rule)
ORDER BY layer_order, active_assignments, size(gaps) DESC, table_label

datasets.name: ds_p5_kpis
queryLines:
-- 5.1 Quarantine KPIs. The framework replaces a quarantine table on every run, so the rows in quarantine are the
-- rows written by each quarantine table's newest run day up to E. New on E = rows written on E, vs the previous run
-- day. Rows = rows_quarantined summed over the rule results (latest result per day).
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
         MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
q AS (
  SELECT coalesce(quarantine_table, quarantine) AS qtable, run_date, e,
         COALESCE(SUM(rows_quarantined), 0) AS rows_q
  FROM f
  WHERE row_level = 'rule'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
newest AS (
  SELECT qtable, MAX_BY(rows_q, run_date) AS rows_now
  FROM q WHERE run_date <= e GROUP BY qtable
),
days AS (
  SELECT run_date, e, SUM(rows_q) AS rows_day FROM q GROUP BY run_date, e
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(rows_now) FROM newest) AS rows_in_quarantine,
  (SELECT COUNT_IF(rows_now > 0) FROM newest) AS quarantine_tables,
  MAX(IF(run_date = e, rows_day, NULL)) AS new_on_e,
  MAX_BY(rows_day, IF(run_date < e, run_date, NULL)) AS new_previous,
  date_format(MAX(e), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS as_of_day
FROM days

datasets.name: ds_p5_ratio
queryLines:
-- 5.5 Quarantine ratio per day in the selected range: rows quarantined / rows evaluated (summed over the rule
-- results, latest result per day; same definition as the page 1 KPI), with the 0.5 % alert line.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
         MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))

datasets.name: ds_p5_lifecycle_kpis
queryLines:
-- 5.1 Released / reprocessed share and oldest row age (demo data; see F_LIFE). released_share = rows of the
-- batches that entered in the selected range and were released or reprocessed by T / all rows that entered in the
-- range. oldest_age_d = age at T of the oldest batch still in quarantine. note = why the values are empty.
WITH t AS (
  SELECT LEAST(m.as_of_ts, CAST(date_add(:run_dates.max, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS t FROM v_data_mode m
),
l AS (
  SELECT q.*, t.t FROM v_quarantine_lifecycle q CROSS JOIN t
  WHERE q.entered_ts < t.t
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT
  SUM(IF(entered_ts >= CAST(:run_dates.min AS TIMESTAMP) AND left_ts <= t AND status IN ('released', 'reprocessed'),
         rows_quarantined, 0))
    / NULLIF(SUM(IF(entered_ts >= CAST(:run_dates.min AS TIMESTAMP), rows_quarantined, 0)), 0) AS released_share,
  MAX(IF(left_ts IS NULL OR left_ts > t, (unix_seconds(t) - unix_seconds(entered_ts)) / 86400.0, NULL)) AS oldest_age_d,
  COALESCE(SUM(IF(left_ts IS NULL OR left_ts > t, rows_quarantined, 0)), 0) AS rows_open,
  IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_quarantine_lifecycle) = 0, 'not recorded by the framework', 'demo data') AS note
FROM l

datasets.name: ds_p5_age_buckets
queryLines:
-- 5.3 Rows still in quarantine at T by age (demo data; see F_LIFE). All four buckets are always returned.
WITH t AS (
  SELECT LEAST(m.as_of_ts, CAST(date_add(:run_dates.max, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS t FROM v_data_mode m
),
l AS (
  SELECT q.*, t.t FROM v_quarantine_lifecycle q CROSS JOIN t
  WHERE q.entered_ts < t.t
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
o AS (
  SELECT rows_quarantined, (unix_seconds(t) - unix_seconds(entered_ts)) / 86400.0 AS age_d
  FROM l WHERE left_ts IS NULL OR left_ts > t
),
b AS (
  SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, '< 1 d'), (2, '1-7 d'), (3, '7-30 d'), (4, '> 30 d') AS b(bucket_order, age_bucket)
)
SELECT b.age_bucket, b.bucket_order, COALESCE(SUM(o.rows_quarantined), 0) AS rows_in_quarantine,
       COUNT(o.rows_quarantined) AS batches
FROM b LEFT JOIN o
  ON b.bucket_order = CASE WHEN o.age_d < 1 THEN 1 WHEN o.age_d < 7 THEN 2 WHEN o.age_d < 30 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
GROUP BY b.age_bucket, b.bucket_order
ORDER BY b.bucket_order

datasets.name: ds_p6_kpis
queryLines:
-- 6.1 Duration KPIs. Last execution = the newest call up to E, vs the median duration of the calls of the same
-- scope (apply_at, project) in the 30 days before it. Per table / per rule / throughput over the 7 days up to E
-- (latest result per day): average table duration, average rule duration, rows evaluated per rule second.
WITH c AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_runs
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
),
last_call AS (
  SELECT MAX_BY(named_struct('ts', run_ts, 'd', duration_s, 'scope', scope, 'day', run_date), run_ts) AS l
  FROM c WHERE run_date <= e
),
med AS (
  SELECT percentile_approx(c.duration_s, 0.5) AS median_30d
  FROM c CROSS JOIN last_call x
  WHERE c.scope = x.l.scope AND c.run_ts < x.l.ts AND c.run_date > date_sub(x.l.day, 30)
),
f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
         MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND row_level = 'rule' AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
w AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(duration_s) AS avg_rule_s,
    SUM(rows_evaluated) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_s), 0) AS rows_per_s
  FROM f WHERE run_date > date_sub(e, 7)
),
tb AS (
  SELECT AVG(table_duration_s) AS avg_table_s
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_table_id, table_duration_s FROM f WHERE run_date > date_sub(e, 7))
)
SELECT
  x.l.d AS last_duration_s, m.median_30d,
  concat(x.l.scope, ', ', date_format(x.l.ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')) AS last_label,
  tb.avg_table_s, w.avg_rule_s, w.rows_per_s
FROM last_call x CROSS JOIN med m CROSS JOIN w CROSS JOIN tb

datasets.name: ds_p6_cost
queryLines:
-- 6.1 DBUs of the jobs that run the checks (v_dq_cost, system.billing): last 7 and 30 billing days up to today
-- (real billing dates, not shifted), list cost in the price currency. note = why the values may be empty.
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(IF(usage_date > date_sub(current_date(), 7), dbus, 0)), 0) AS dbus_7d,
  COALESCE(SUM(IF(usage_date > date_sub(current_date(), 30), dbus, 0)), 0) AS dbus_30d,
  COALESCE(SUM(IF(usage_date > date_sub(current_date(), 7), list_cost, 0)), 0) AS cost_7d,
  COALESCE(MAX(currency), 'USD') AS currency,
  IF(COUNT(*) = 0, 'no billing rows for the check jobs yet', concat('billing up to ', CAST(MAX(usage_date) AS STRING)))
    AS note
FROM v_dq_cost

datasets.name: ds_p6_duration_trend
queryLines:
-- 6.2 Duration per run day over the 90 days up to E: sum of the durations of the day's newest call per scope.
-- p90 = 90th percentile of the daily durations in the window; regression = more than 1.3 x the median of the
-- previous 14 run days (at least 5).
WITH c AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_runs
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
),
d AS (
  SELECT run_date, SUM(duration_s) / 60.0 AS duration_min, COUNT(*) AS calls
  FROM c WHERE run_date > date_sub(e, 90)
  GROUP BY run_date
),
r AS (
  SELECT *,
         percentile_approx(duration_min, 0.5) OVER (ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS median_prev,
         COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY run_date ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS n_prev,
         percentile_approx(duration_min, 0.9) OVER () AS p90
  FROM d
)
SELECT run_date, duration_min, calls, p90, median_prev,
       IF(n_prev >= 5 AND duration_min > 1.3 * median_prev, 'regression', 'normal') AS kind
FROM r
ORDER BY run_date

datasets.name: ds_p6_dbu_by_project
queryLines:
-- 6.3 DBUs of the last 30 billing days (v_dq_cost) split by project, in proportion to each project's rule
-- seconds in the real runs started in the same 30 days (real dates; '(project-agnostic)' = no project).
-- An allocation, not a measurement: billing is per job, not per project.
WITH b AS (
  SELECT SUM(dbus) AS dbus FROM v_dq_cost WHERE usage_date > date_sub(current_date(), 30)
),
s AS (
  SELECT coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)') AS project, SUM(duration_s) AS rule_s
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE NOT is_synthetic AND row_level = 'rule' AND CAST(start_timestamp AS DATE) > date_sub(current_date(), 30)
    AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.project, s.rule_s, b.dbus * s.rule_s / SUM(s.rule_s) OVER () AS dbus
FROM s CROSS JOIN b
WHERE b.dbus IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dbus DESC

datasets.name: ds_p6_timeline
queryLines:
-- 6.4 Timeline of E: every table of the day's newest calls, from its start to its end (call start + offset of the
-- table inside the call), colored by table status.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
         MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND row_level = 'rule' AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
tbl AS (
  SELECT result_table_id, MAX(apply_at) AS apply_at, MAX(project) AS project, MAX(table_label) AS table_label,
         MAX(run_ts) AS call_ts, MIN(start_timestamp_execution) AS exec_start, MIN(start_timestamp_table) AS t_start,
         MAX(table_duration_s) AS table_s, MAX(table_status) AS table_status, COUNT(*) AS rules
  FROM f WHERE run_date = e
  GROUP BY result_table_id
)
SELECT concat(apply_at, CASE WHEN project IS NULL THEN '' ELSE concat(' / ', project) END, ' · ', table_label) AS call_table,
       timestampadd(MILLISECOND, CAST(1000 * (unix_millis(t_start) - unix_millis(exec_start)) / 1000 AS BIGINT), call_ts) AS start_ts,
       timestampadd(MILLISECOND, CAST(1000 * (unix_millis(t_start) - unix_millis(exec_start)) / 1000 + 1000 * table_s AS BIGINT), call_ts) AS end_ts,
       table_s, rules,
       CASE table_status WHEN 'code_error' THEN 'code_error / no run' ELSE table_status END AS status
FROM tbl
ORDER BY start_ts

datasets.name: ds_p6_slowest_rules
queryLines:
-- 6.5 Slowest rule assignments: average seconds per run in the selected range (latest result per day). Top 10.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
         MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND row_level = 'rule' AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT concat(rule_label_base, ' · ', table_name) AS rule_table, rule_dimension, AVG(duration_s) AS avg_s, COUNT(*) AS runs
FROM (SELECT f.*, concat(rule_name, COALESCE(concat('(', COALESCE(get_json_object(parameters_identifiers, '$.column'),
              array_join(from_json(get_json_object(parameters_identifiers, '$.columns'), 'ARRAY<STRING>'), ', ')), ')'), ''))
              AS rule_label_base FROM f WHERE run_date >= :run_dates.min AND duration_s IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY avg_s DESC, rule_table
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_p6_duration_vs_rows
queryLines:
-- 6.6 Duration vs rows evaluated: one point per rule assignment, averages over the selected range (latest
-- result per day). Points far above the others for their row count are expensive checks.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT *, concat(`schema`, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
         MAX(IF(run_date >= :run_dates.min, run_date, NULL)) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND row_level = 'rule' AND run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT concat(rule_name, ' · ', table_name) AS rule_table, rule_name, engine_type,
       AVG(rows_evaluated) AS avg_rows, AVG(duration_s) AS avg_s, COUNT(*) AS runs
FROM f
WHERE run_date >= :run_dates.min AND duration_s IS NOT NULL AND rows_evaluated IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rule_assignment_id, 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY avg_s DESC

datasets.name: ds_p7_kpis
queryLines:
-- 7.1 Incident KPIs. Open = not resolved at E. MTTD (approximation) = hours from the previous run of the rule to
-- the run that detected the failure, incidents detected in the range. MTTR = hours from detection to the first
-- passing run, incidents resolved in the range. Alerts and noise ratio from v_alerts (demo data): alerts sent in the
-- 7 days up to E; noise = alerts assessed as noise / assessed alerts in the 30 days up to E.
WITH e AS (
  SELECT MAX(run_date) AS e FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
),
i AS (
  SELECT v.*, e.e,
         CASE WHEN v.resolved_ts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.resolved_ts AS DATE) <= e.e THEN 'resolved'
              WHEN v.acknowledged_ts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.acknowledged_ts AS DATE) <= e.e THEN 'acknowledged'
              ELSE 'open' END AS state_at_e
  FROM v_incidents v CROSS JOIN e
  WHERE v.started_on <= e.e
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
a AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT_IF(sent_date > date_sub(e.e, 7) AND sent_date <= e.e) AS alerts_7d,
    COUNT_IF(outcome = 'noise' AND sent_date > date_sub(e.e, 30) AND sent_date <= e.e)
      / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(outcome <> 'not assessed' AND sent_date > date_sub(e.e, 30) AND sent_date <= e.e), 0) AS noise_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS alerts_all
  FROM v_alerts CROSS JOIN e
  WHERE TRUE
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT
  COUNT_IF(i.state_at_e <> 'resolved') AS open_incidents,
  COUNT_IF(i.state_at_e = 'acknowledged') AS acknowledged,
  AVG(IF(i.started_on >= :run_dates.min, i.time_to_detect_h, NULL)) AS mttd_h,
  AVG(IF(CAST(i.resolved_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND i.e, i.time_to_resolve_h, NULL)) AS mttr_h,
  MAX(a.alerts_7d) AS alerts_7d, MAX(a.noise_ratio) AS noise_ratio,
  IF(MAX(a.alerts_all) = 0, 'not recorded by the framework', 'demo data') AS alerts_note
FROM i CROSS JOIN a

datasets.name: ds_p7_timeline
queryLines:
-- 7.2 Incident timeline: incidents active in the 14 days up to E, from detection to resolution (or E when not
-- resolved at E), colored by their state at E. The 30 most relevant: open first, then high criticality, longest.
WITH e AS (
  SELECT MAX(run_date) AS e FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
),
i AS (
  SELECT v.*, e.e,
         CASE WHEN v.resolved_ts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.resolved_ts AS DATE) <= e.e THEN 'resolved'
              WHEN v.acknowledged_ts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.acknowledged_ts AS DATE) <= e.e THEN 'acknowledged'
              ELSE 'open' END AS state_at_e
  FROM v_incidents v CROSS JOIN e
  WHERE v.started_on <= e.e
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT concat(incident_id, ' · ', rule_label, ' · ', table_name) AS incident,
       GREATEST(detected_ts, CAST(date_sub(e, 13) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS start_ts,
       IF(state_at_e = 'resolved', resolved_ts, CAST(date_add(e, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS end_ts,
       state_at_e AS state, criticality, failing_runs
FROM i
WHERE COALESCE(CAST(resolved_ts AS DATE), date_add(e, 1)) > date_sub(e, 13)
ORDER BY CASE state_at_e WHEN 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE criticality WHEN 'high' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         failing_runs DESC, incident
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: ds_p7_incidents
queryLines:
-- 7.3 Incidents not resolved at E, and incidents resolved in the selected range. Age = days from detection to
-- E (open) or to resolution. Owner and acknowledgement are demo data ('n/a' when not recorded).
WITH e AS (
  SELECT MAX(run_date) AS e FROM v_results_all
  WHERE is_latest_for_day AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
),
i AS (
  SELECT v.*, e.e,
         CASE WHEN v.resolved_ts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.resolved_ts AS DATE) <= e.e THEN 'resolved'
              WHEN v.acknowledged_ts IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.acknowledged_ts AS DATE) <= e.e THEN 'acknowledged'
              ELSE 'open' END AS state_at_e
  FROM v_incidents v CROSS JOIN e
  WHERE v.started_on <= e.e
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
al AS (SELECT incident_key, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM v_alerts GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
  i.incident_id, i.table_label, i.rule_label, i.criticality, i.rule_dimension,
  CASE i.state_at_e WHEN 'open' THEN '🟥 open' WHEN 'acknowledged' THEN '🟧 acknowledged' ELSE '🟩 resolved' END AS state,
  COALESCE(i.owner, 'n/a') AS owner,
  ROUND((unix_seconds(IF(i.state_at_e = 'resolved', i.resolved_ts, CAST(date_add(i.e, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)))
         - unix_seconds(i.detected_ts)) / 86400.0, 1) AS age_d,
  date_format(i.detected_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS detected,
  date_format(IF(i.state_at_e = 'resolved', i.resolved_ts, NULL), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS resolved,
  i.failing_runs, COALESCE(al.alerts, 0) AS alerts,
  CASE i.state_at_e WHEN 'open' THEN 0 WHEN 'acknowledged' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS sort_key
FROM i LEFT JOIN al ON al.incident_key = i.incident_key
WHERE i.state_at_e <> 'resolved' OR CAST(i.resolved_ts AS DATE) >= :run_dates.min
ORDER BY sort_key, CASE i.criticality WHEN 'high' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.detected_ts DESC

datasets.name: ds_p7_alert_outcomes
queryLines:
-- 7.4 Outcome of the alerts sent in the selected range (demo data): fixed, accepted risk, noise, not assessed.
SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS alerts
FROM v_alerts
WHERE sent_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY alerts DESC

datasets.name: ds_p7_missed_runs
queryLines:
-- 7.5 Runs per scope (apply_at / project) and day in the selected range. Expected: one call per scope and day
-- (the run policy has no schedule), from the scope's first call. run = one call, rerun = more than one call,
-- missed = no call. day is a 'yyyy-MM-dd' string (the grid's axis labels slice it). Only the Project filter applies (calls have no layer, catalog, criticality or dimension).
WITH c AS (
  SELECT scope, run_date, COUNT(*) AS calls
  FROM v_runs
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
s AS (
  SELECT scope, MIN(run_date) AS first_day FROM c GROUP BY scope
),
grid AS (
  SELECT s.scope, d.day
  FROM s
  LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(GREATEST(s.first_day, :run_dates.min), :run_dates.max)) d AS day
)
SELECT g.scope, date_format(g.day, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS day, COALESCE(c.calls, 0) AS calls,
       CASE WHEN c.calls IS NULL THEN 'missed' WHEN c.calls > 1 THEN 'rerun' ELSE 'run' END AS status
FROM grid g LEFT JOIN c ON c.scope = g.scope AND c.run_date = g.day
WHERE g.day <= (SELECT MAX(run_date) FROM c)
ORDER BY g.scope, g.day

datasets.name: ds_p8_kpis
queryLines:
-- 8.1 Catalog coverage: tables in the schemas that hold registered tables with at least one effective active rule,
-- registered tables, uncovered tables; configuration changes in the selected range (all sources).
WITH c AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_catalog_coverage WHERE TRUE
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
),
ch AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS changes FROM v_config_changes WHERE change_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
)
SELECT COUNT_IF(is_covered) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS coverage, COUNT_IF(is_covered) AS covered, COUNT(*) AS tables,
       COUNT_IF(is_registered) AS registered, COUNT_IF(NOT is_covered) AS uncovered, MAX(ch.changes) AS changes
FROM c CROSS JOIN ch

datasets.name: ds_p8_rules_dim_crit
queryLines:
-- 8.2 Effective active rule assignments by dimension and criticality.
SELECT rule_dimension, criticality, COUNT(*) AS rules
FROM v_assignment_active
WHERE is_effective_active
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_p8_rules_breakdown
datasets.displayName: 8 Rules by type, engine, apply at
queryLines:
-- 8.3 Rule assignments by rule type, engine and apply_at, active vs inactive (inactive = any of the five
-- is_active flags is false).
WITH a AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_assignment_active WHERE TRUE
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
)
SELECT concat(facet, ': ', value) AS item, facet, value, IF(is_effective_active, 'active', 'inactive') AS state,
       COUNT(*) AS rules
FROM a
LATERAL VIEW stack(3, 'rule type', rule_type, 'engine', engine_type, 'apply at', apply_at) f AS facet, value
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY facet, rules DESC

datasets.name: ds_p8_uncovered
queryLines:
-- 8.4 Tables without effective active rules in the schemas that hold registered tables, most read first (reads =
-- getTable events in system.access.audit, last 30 days).
SELECT table_label, catalog, data_layer, IF(is_registered, 'yes', 'no') AS registered, reads_30d, table_type
FROM v_catalog_coverage
WHERE NOT is_covered
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
ORDER BY reads_30d DESC, table_label

datasets.name: ds_p8_change_log
queryLines:
-- 8.5 Configuration change log in the selected range, newest first. Sources: Delta history of the configuration
-- tables, SCD2 rows of rule_assignment, demo change history (rule added / changed / disabled, threshold changed).
SELECT date_format(change_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS changed_at, changed_by, change_type, object_label, table_label,
       field_name, concat_ws(' -> ', old_value, new_value) AS change, source, change_ts
FROM v_config_changes
WHERE change_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
ORDER BY change_ts DESC

datasets.name: ds_p8_impact
queryLines:
-- 8.6 Impact of a configuration change: the table with the newest rule-level change (threshold changed, rule
-- changed or disabled) in the selected range; its daily DQ score over the 30 days up to E and its change dates.
-- kind = 'score' rows (day, score) and 'change' rows (day, label). day is a 'yyyy-MM-dd' string.
WITH ch AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_config_changes
  WHERE change_type IN ('threshold changed', 'rule changed', 'rule disabled')
    AND change_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_project) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_project, coalesce(project, '(project-agnostic)')))
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
  AND (size(:f_criticality) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_criticality, criticality))
  AND (size(:f_dimension) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_dimension, rule_dimension))
),
pick AS (
  SELECT MAX_BY(table_id, change_ts) AS table_id FROM ch
),
d AS (
  SELECT v.run_date, v.table_label, v.is_pass, v.is_scored,
         MAX(v.run_date) OVER () AS e
  FROM v_rule_daily v JOIN pick p ON v.table_id = p.table_id
  WHERE v.run_date <= :run_dates.max
)
SELECT 'score' AS kind, date_format(run_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS day, MAX(table_label) AS table_label,
       COUNT_IF(is_pass) / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored), 0) AS score, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS label
FROM d WHERE run_date > date_sub(e, 30)
GROUP BY run_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'change', date_format(c.change_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), MAX(c.table_label), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
       concat_ws('; ', collect_list(concat(c.change_type, ' (', c.object_label, ')')))
FROM ch c JOIN pick p ON c.table_id = p.table_id
GROUP BY c.change_date
ORDER BY kind DESC, day

datasets.name: ds_p9_kpis
queryLines:
-- 9.1 Mappings and the status of their newest reconciliation run up to the end of the range. note = why the values
-- may be empty (no reconciliation runs).
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mapping ORDER BY execution_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM v_recon_runs
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS mappings, COUNT_IF(status = 'match') AS matched, COUNT_IF(status = 'partial') AS partial,
       COUNT_IF(status = 'mismatch') AS mismatch,
       IF(COUNT(*) = 0, 'no reconciliation runs', 'demo data') AS note
FROM r WHERE rn = 1

datasets.name: ds_p9_progress
queryLines:
-- 9.2 Migration progress: mappings by status per reconciliation day in the selected range (each mapping's run of
-- that day).
SELECT date_format(run_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS run_day, status, COUNT(DISTINCT mapping) AS mappings
FROM v_recon_runs
WHERE run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_p9_mappings
queryLines:
-- 9.3 Mappings with their newest run up to the end of the range: rows old / new, change, mismatched columns
-- (type or name), rows only in the old / new table.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mapping ORDER BY execution_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM v_recon_runs
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
)
SELECT mapping, old_table, new_table,
       CASE status WHEN 'match' THEN '🟩 match' WHEN 'partial' THEN '🟧 partial' ELSE '🟥 mismatch' END AS status,
       rows_old, rows_new, rows_change, type_mismatches + name_mismatches AS mismatched_columns,
       only_in_old, only_in_new, date_format(execution_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS last_run,
       CASE status WHEN 'mismatch' THEN 0 WHEN 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS sort_key
FROM r WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY sort_key, mapping

datasets.name: ds_p9_columns
queryLines:
-- 9.4 Columns with the most failed column checks in the selected range: data type differs (data_types) or the
-- column exists on one side only (column_names). Top 10.
SELECT concat(col, ' · ', mapping) AS column_mapping, kind, COUNT(*) AS failed_checks
FROM (
  SELECT mapping, run_date,
         CASE reconciliation_type WHEN 'data_types' THEN additional_info ELSE lower(COALESCE(result_old, result_new)) END AS col,
         CASE reconciliation_type WHEN 'data_types' THEN 'type differs' ELSE 'name differs' END AS kind
  FROM v_recon_results
  WHERE result_status = 'fail' AND reconciliation_type IN ('data_types', 'column_names')
    AND run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY failed_checks DESC, column_mapping
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_p9_convergence
queryLines:
-- 9.5 Rows that differ (only in the old + only in the new table) per mapping and reconciliation run in the
-- selected range.
SELECT execution_timestamp, run_date, mapping, only_in_old + only_in_new AS rows_differing
FROM v_recon_runs
WHERE run_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
ORDER BY execution_timestamp

datasets.name: ds_p9_only_in
queryLines:
-- 9.6 Rows only in the old table vs only in the new table per mapping, newest run up to the end of the range.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mapping ORDER BY execution_timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM v_recon_runs
  WHERE run_date <= :run_dates.max
)
SELECT mapping, side, rows_
FROM r
LATERAL VIEW stack(2, 'only in old', only_in_old, 'only in new', only_in_new) s AS side, rows_
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY mapping, side

datasets.name: ds_p10_kpis
queryLines:
-- 10.5 Schema change KPIs in the selected range: events, tables affected, columns removed, events on columns that
-- rules use. note = what the events come from.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_schema_changes
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT table_label) AS tables, COUNT_IF(change_type = 'column removed') AS removed,
       COUNT_IF(rules_on_column > 0) AS on_rule_columns,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT_IF(is_synthetic) FROM v_schema_changes) > 0 THEN 'snapshots + demo data'
            ELSE 'from daily column snapshots' END AS note
FROM s

datasets.name: ds_p10_per_day
queryLines:
-- 10.5 Schema change events per day and change type in the selected range.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_schema_changes
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
)
SELECT event_date, change_type, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_p10_tables
queryLines:
-- 10.5 Tables with the most schema change events in the selected range. Top 10.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_schema_changes
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
)
SELECT table_label, change_type, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY events DESC, table_label LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_p10_events
queryLines:
-- 10.5 Schema change events in the selected range, newest first: when, table, column, change, old -> new type,
-- rules on the column (impact), source (daily column snapshots or demo data).
WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_schema_changes
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN :run_dates.min AND :run_dates.max
  AND (size(:f_layer) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_layer, data_layer))
  AND (size(:f_catalog) = 0 OR array_contains(:f_catalog, catalog))
)
SELECT date_format(event_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS changed_at, table_label, column_name, change_type,
       concat(COALESCE(old_type, '-'), ' -> ', COALESCE(new_type, '-')) AS type_change, rules_on_column,
       IF(rules_on_column > 0, '🟧 used by rules', '') AS impact, data_layer, source, event_ts
FROM s
ORDER BY event_ts DESC, table_label, column_name
